title: github-ops operation catalog (provider interface)
description: The interface every github-ops provider implements. Each operation is one capability a loop can invoke by NAME; a provider is a reference file that maps every operation of its axis to a concrete command/tool. Axes: 'forge' = the git host (implemented by gh-cli.md and github-mcp.md), 'ci' = the CI system (implemented by the ci_provider references — github-checks in gh-cli/github-mcp, azure-pipelines.md). To add a provider outside gh / GitHub-checks / Azure Pipelines, implement every operation of the matching axis.

axis.description: Which provider kind must implement this operation.

gate.description: True if this operation is a merge/CI gate loops must not bypass.
